about_the_game:
A Slime that Evolves through Absorption and Transformation!

A unique action mechanic where you absorb enemies and freely use their forms and powers.

You're not just a typical monster.
You can transform into the humans and creatures you absorb—taking on not only their appearance but also their attack styles, skills, and even passive abilities.
Fight in their way, master their power, and forge your own path through a ruined world.
One character, countless ways to fight.

The Journey of a Slime Awakened in a World of Magic and Machinery

A dystopia where magic and technology, love and guilt, life and destruction intertwine.

This world was once full of prosperity.
But human ambition to modify life itself through technology brought it to ruin.
Now, in a wasteland where machines and living beings are tangled together, a single slime awakens.
Each stage unveils a different aspect of this fallen world—one filled with sorrow, beauty, and terrifying truths.
Dive into a breathtakingly brutal dystopia.

Transform into Warriors, Elves, and Hunters—Each with Unique Styles and Skills!

Every form you absorb demands a different strategy.

Each creature you absorb comes with a distinct combat style, unique skills, and specialized passives.
Charge forward as a close-range warrior, dominate from mid-range as a hunter, or control the battlefield from afar as a spell-casting elf.
Adapt to every situation by switching forms, crafting your own playstyle and tactical approach.
There’s no single way to play—only your way.

A Story-Driven Stage-Clear System Beyond Ordinary Action Games

The more you play, the deeper you fall into the world.

Each stage is crafted like a chapter—offering boss battles, challenge conditions, and shifting gameplay mechanics that keep things fresh.
But this isn't just about clearing stages.
You’ll constantly ask yourself: “Why am I fighting?” “What lies at the end of this path?”
Story and gameplay are seamlessly intertwined, ensuring every moment holds meaning.
Explore a world where beauty and brutality coexist—and feel something new in every step.

Who or What Is the Slime?

The slime awakens with no memory of who or what it truly is.
A mysterious voice echoes from within, guiding it through a shattered world.
As the journey unfolds, puzzle pieces begin to align.
This isn’t the tale of a typical hero.
It’s a story that asks far deeper questions.

Core Features

  • Absorb and transform into a wide range of creatures, each with distinct combat styles

  • Strategic gameplay through unique skills, passives, and tactics for every transformation

  • A dystopian world born of clashing magic and machinery, layered with narrative depth

  • Story-rich stage-clear structure, where every level is a meaningful step in your journey

  • Emotional pixel art visuals, blending dark fantasy with haunting beauty

  • Fully supports keyboard and gamepad, designed for immersive play across all setups

short_description: A slime with no memory of who—or what—it is. Absorb others, wield their powers, and embark on a journey to save the world and discover your true identity. Experience souls-like action in a brutal yet beautiful dystopia where magic and machines collide.
